opening.argument: The interview presents MTI as a Bitcoin-in, Bitcoin-out opportunity that can help ordinary participants grow their Bitcoin, while offering a 10% referral fee and an opportunity to generate a second income. It attributes exceptional performance to a trading bot maintained and adjusted for market conditions, then expressly invites interested viewers to grow their Bitcoin with MTI. The sponsor-curated end card reinforces that invitation by displaying MTI sign-up links and two MTI-related web addresses. Although MTI says it does not guarantee results, the available evidence does not verify trading performance, referral payments, or what follows from using those links. The combination of promised opportunity, referral incentive, and direct participation route establishes the deceptive promotional character at issue.
